summary.text: Carrie Satterwhite is the Libertarian candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 50, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Carrie Satterwhite was the Libertarian candidate for Wyoming House of Representatives District 50 in 2022, when incumbent Rachel Rodriguez-Williams (R) defeated her in the general election on November 8, 2022, with Satterwhite receiving 16.9 percent of the vote.
